mappings.rationale: Filters malicious spearphishing attachments before delivery and reduces initial-access success.
Detects and constrains suspicious PowerShell execution, encoded commands, and script interpreter abuse.
Reduces credential dumping impact by hardening credential stores and monitoring privileged credential access.
Limits SMB and Windows Admin Share lateral movement by constraining reachable administrative paths.
Reduces ransomware impact by preserving recoverable copies of encrypted data and shortening restoration time.
Identifies suspicious ingress tool transfer and command-and-control staging over network channels.
Raises the cost of valid-account abuse and blocks many credential-only access paths.
Detects attempts to disable security tools and preserves defensive visibility during attack execution.
